chapters.label: Set and strike
chapters.text: The Etihad, final day. Win, and Manchester City are champions. Two minutes in, Bernardo Silva squares it to Phil Foden, in sky blue. One touch, then bang! Top corner!

chapters.label: Across his body
chapters.text: Watch again. His first touch takes it across his body, away from the defender, set for his left foot.

chapters.label: No time
chapters.text: The keeper has no time to get set. City won the league that day!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: one touch to set the ball, then strike it low and quick, before the keeper is ready!
